items.name: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu V 2024
items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.name: Götalandsmästerskapet 2024
items.information: Välkomna till Götalandsmästerskapet 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Götaland som kan vinna titlar och priser på Götalandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2024#43304-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". ----- Welcome to Götalandsmästerskapet 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Götaland can win titles and prizes at the Götaland Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeasociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2024#43304-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzYzMTIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--77b92cc72863445569af65c368f89eb5010927d0/CUBO_colores.png) Bienvenido a UC al Cubo! La primera competencia oficial de speedcubing en la Universidad Católica. Nos encontraremos en un espacio de sana competencia y autosuperación en la sala de estudio del primer piso del edificio Felipe Villanueva, en la Facultad de Matemáticas ubicada en el Campus San Joaquín UC, en la comuna de Macul. Welcome to UC al Cubo! The first official speedcubing competition at Universidad Católica. We will meet in a space of healthy competition and self-improvement in the study room on the first floor of the Felipe Villanueva building, in the Faculty of Mathematics located on the San Joaquín UC Campus, in the commune of Macul.
